column2:
social(adj.)社會的、社交的
society(n.)社會
socially(adv.)社交上
social media 社群媒體
social skills 社交能力
Many teens spend hours on social media.
(許多青少年花好幾個小時在社群媒體上。)
Good social skills help you make friends.
(良好的社交能力幫助你交朋友。)

society(n.)社會、協會
social(adj.)社會的
modern society 現代社會
member of society 社會的一份子
Computers play a big role in modern society.
(電腦在現代社會中扮演重要角色。)
He joined the school's music society.
(他加入了學校的音樂社。)

sock(n.)短襪、socks(n.)一雙襪子
(無詞性變化)
a pair of socks 一雙襪子
wool socks 羊毛襪
I need a new pair of socks.
(我需要一雙新襪子。)
He wore one red sock and one blue sock.
(他穿了一隻紅襪和一隻藍襪。)

soda(n.)汽水、蘇打水
(無詞性變化)
a can of soda 一罐汽水
soda water 蘇打水
Too much soda is bad for your teeth.
(喝太多汽水對牙齒不好。)
He ordered a can of soda with his burger.
(他點漢堡時配了一罐汽水。)

soft(adj.)柔軟的、輕柔的、溫和的
soften(v.)使變軟
softly(adv.)輕柔地
soft drink 不含酒精的飲料
soft voice 輕柔的聲音
This pillow is very soft.
(這個枕頭非常柔軟。)
She spoke in a soft voice.
(她用輕柔的聲音說話。)

soil(n.)土壤、土地
(無詞性變化)
rich soil 肥沃的土壤
soil pollution 土壤汙染
Plants grow well in rich soil.
(植物在肥沃的土壤中長得很好。)
The farmer checked the soil before planting.
(農夫在種植前檢查土壤。)

solution(n.)解決辦法、答案、溶液
solve(v.)解決
find a solution 找到解決辦法
solution to ……的解決辦法
We need to find a solution quickly.
(我們需要盡快找到解決辦法。)
Is there a solution to this problem?
(這個問題有解決辦法嗎？)

solve(v.)解決、解答
solution(n.)解決辦法
solve a problem 解決問題
solve a mystery 解開謎團
Can you solve this math problem?
(你會解這道數學題嗎？)
The police finally solved the case.
(警方終於破案了。)

somewhat(adv.)有點、稍微
(無詞性變化)
somewhat different 有點不同
somewhat surprised 有點驚訝
I was somewhat surprised by the news.
(我對這個消息有點驚訝。)
The test was somewhat harder than I expected.
(這次考試比我預期的難一點。)

sort(n./v.)種類、分類、整理
(無詞性變化)
sort of 有點
sort out 整理、解決
What sort of music do you like?
(你喜歡哪一種音樂？)
Please sort the trash before you throw it away.
(丟垃圾前請先分類。)

soul(n.)靈魂、心靈、人
(無詞性變化)
body and soul 全心全意
not a soul 一個人也沒有
There was not a soul on the street.
(街上一個人也沒有。)
Music is food for the soul.
(音樂是心靈的食糧。)

sour(adj./n./v.)酸的、酸味、變酸
(無詞性變化)
sweet and sour 糖醋的
turn sour 變酸、變糟
The milk has gone sour.
(牛奶已經酸掉了。)
I love sweet and sour pork.
(我很愛吃糖醋里肌。)

source(n.)來源、根源、出處
(無詞性變化)
source of income 收入來源
energy source 能源
Fruit is a good source of vitamins.
(水果是維他命的良好來源。)
The sun is our main energy source.
(太陽是我們主要的能源。)

southern(adj.)南方的、南部的
south(n.)南方
southern Taiwan 南台灣
southern part 南部
Kaohsiung is in southern Taiwan.
(高雄位於南台灣。)
It is warmer in the southern part of the island.
(島嶼的南部比較溫暖。)

soybean(n.)黃豆、大豆
(無詞性變化)
soybean milk 豆漿
soybean oil 大豆油
Tofu is made from soybeans.
(豆腐是由黃豆做成的。)
I drink soybean milk every morning.
(我每天早上喝豆漿。)

speaker(n.)演講者、說話者、喇叭
speak(v.)說話
native speaker 母語人士
guest speaker 客座講者
Our teacher is a native speaker of English.
(我們的老師是以英文為母語的人。)
Turn up the speaker, please.
(請把喇叭的音量調大。)

speech(n.)演講、說話能力
speak(v.)說話
give a speech 發表演說
speech contest 演講比賽
The principal gave a speech this morning.
(校長今天早上發表了演說。)
She won first place in the speech contest.
(她在演講比賽中得了第一名。)

speed(n./v.)速度、加速、超速
speedy(adj.)快速的
speed limit 速限
at full speed 全速
The speed limit here is 50 kilometers per hour.
(這裡的速限是每小時五十公里。)
The train ran at full speed.
(火車全速行駛。)

spelling(n.)拼字、拼法
spell(v.)拼寫
spelling mistake 拼字錯誤
spelling test 拼字測驗
Check your spelling before you hand it in.
(交出去之前檢查一下你的拼字。)
I got full marks on the spelling test.
(我拼字測驗拿了滿分。)

spider(n.)蜘蛛
(無詞性變化)
spider web 蜘蛛網
poisonous spider 毒蜘蛛
There is a big spider on the wall.
(牆上有一隻大蜘蛛。)
The spider is making a web.
(蜘蛛正在結網。)

spirit(n.)精神、心情、靈魂
spiritual(adj.)精神上的
team spirit 團隊精神
in high spirits 興高采烈
Our class has great team spirit.
(我們班很有團隊精神。)
Everyone was in high spirits at the party.
(派對上每個人都興高采烈。)

spoon(n.)湯匙
spoonful(n.)一匙的量
a spoon of sugar 一匙糖
soup spoon 湯匙
Can I have a spoon, please?
(可以給我一支湯匙嗎？)
She added a spoon of sugar to her tea.
(她在茶裡加了一匙糖。)

sport(n./v.)運動、運動會、穿戴(展示)
sporty(adj.)愛運動的
sports(adj.)運動的
play sports 做運動
sports car 跑車
Basketball is my favorite sport.
(籃球是我最喜歡的運動。)
He plays sports every day after school.
(他每天放學後都做運動。)

spot(n./v.)地點、斑點、看見、認出
spotless(adj.)一塵不染的
tourist spot 觀光景點
on the spot 當場
Sun Moon Lake is a famous tourist spot.
(日月潭是有名的觀光景點。)
I spotted my friend in the crowd.
(我在人群中認出了我的朋友。)

spread(v./n.)散布、傳播、塗、展開、蔓延
(無詞性變化)
spread the news 散播消息
spread butter 塗奶油
The news spread quickly at school.
(這個消息在學校裡很快傳開。)
She spread butter on her toast.
(她在吐司上塗奶油。)

stage(n./v.)舞台、階段、上演
(無詞性變化)
on stage 在舞台上
early stage 早期階段
She sang a song on stage.
(她在舞台上唱了一首歌。)
The project is still at an early stage.
(這個計畫仍處於早期階段。)

stamp(n./v.)郵票、印章、蓋章、跺腳
(無詞性變化)
collect stamps 集郵
stamp one's foot 跺腳
My grandpa likes to collect stamps.
(我爺爺喜歡集郵。)
The officer stamped my passport.
(那位官員在我的護照上蓋了章。)

standard(adj./n.)標準的、標準、水準
standardize(v.)使標準化
high standard 高標準
standard of living 生活水準
The school has high standards for students.
(這所學校對學生要求很高。)
Their standard of living has improved.
(他們的生活水準提高了。)

state(v.)陳述、說明、statement(n.)聲明、陳述
state(n.)州、狀態、國家
make a statement 發表聲明
clearly state 清楚說明
Please state your name and age.
(請說出你的姓名和年齡。)
The company made a statement about the problem.
(公司就這個問題發表了聲明。)

steak(n.)牛排
(無詞性變化)
rare steak 三分熟的牛排
steak house 牛排館
How would you like your steak?
(你的牛排要幾分熟？)
We had steak for my dad's birthday.
(我們為爸爸慶生吃了牛排。)

steel(n./v.)鋼、鋼鐵、使堅強
(無詞性變化)
stainless steel 不鏽鋼
steel oneself 使自己堅強起來
The bridge is made of steel.
(這座橋是用鋼鐵建造的。)
He steeled himself for the bad news.
(他做好心理準備面對壞消息。)

step(n./v.)步、步驟、台階、踏
(無詞性變化)
step by step 一步一步地
take a step 採取一步
Learn English step by step.
(一步一步地學英文。)
Watch your step. The floor is wet.
(小心腳步，地板是濕的。)

stick(v./n.)黏貼、刺、堅持、棍子
sticky(adj.)黏的
sticker(n.)貼紙
stick to 堅持
walking stick 手杖
Stick the stamp on the envelope.
(把郵票貼在信封上。)
You should stick to your plan.
(你應該堅持你的計畫。)

stomachache(n.)胃痛、肚子痛
stomach(n.)胃、肚子
have a stomachache 胃痛
bad stomachache 嚴重的胃痛
I have a stomachache after eating too much.
(我吃太多之後肚子痛。)
He missed school because of a bad stomachache.
(他因為嚴重的胃痛沒去上學。)

stone(n./v.)石頭、寶石、向…扔石頭
stony(adj.)多石的、冷漠的
throw a stone 丟石頭
stone wall 石牆
Don't throw stones at the dogs.
(不要向狗丟石頭。)
The old house has a stone wall.
(那棟老房子有一道石牆。)

storm(n./v.)暴風雨、猛攻、怒氣沖沖地走
stormy(adj.)暴風雨的
heavy storm 強烈暴風雨
storm out 氣沖沖地離開
The storm knocked down many trees.
(暴風雨吹倒了許多樹。)
She stormed out of the room angrily.
(她氣沖沖地走出房間。)

stranger(n.)陌生人、外地人
strange(adj.)奇怪的、陌生的
complete stranger 完全陌生的人
talk to strangers 和陌生人說話
Don't talk to strangers.
(不要和陌生人說話。)
I'm a stranger here myself.
(我自己也是初來乍到。)

strawberry(n.)草莓
(無詞性變化)
strawberry jam 草莓果醬
strawberry farm 草莓園
We picked strawberries in Dahu.
(我們去大湖採草莓。)
I'd like some strawberry jam on my bread.
(我想在麵包上塗一些草莓果醬。)

stream(n./v.)小溪、一連串、流動、串流
streaming(n.)串流
mountain stream 山澗
live stream 直播
The children played in the mountain stream.
(孩子們在山澗中玩水。)
We watched a live stream of the concert.
(我們看了演唱會的直播。)

stress(n./v.)壓力、重音、強調
stressful(adj.)壓力大的
stressed(adj.)感到壓力的
under stress 承受壓力
reduce stress 減輕壓力
Exercise can help reduce stress.
(運動可以幫助減輕壓力。)
The teacher stressed the importance of sleep.
(老師強調睡眠的重要性。)

stretch(n./v.)伸展、延伸、一段
stretchy(adj.)有彈性的
stretch out 伸展
stretch one's legs 舒展筋骨、散步
Stretch your arms before you swim.
(游泳前先伸展手臂。)
The beach stretches for miles.
(這片海灘綿延數英里。)

strict(adj.)嚴格的
strictly(adv.)嚴格地
be strict with 對…嚴格
strict rules 嚴格的規定
My parents are very strict with me.
(我的父母對我很嚴格。)
The school has strict rules about phones.
(學校對手機有嚴格的規定。)

strike(n./v.)罷工、打擊、襲擊、突然想到
striking(adj.)顯著的、引人注目的
go on strike 罷工
strike sb. as 給某人…的印象
The workers went on strike for higher pay.
(工人們為了加薪而罷工。)
The house was struck by lightning.
(那棟房子被閃電擊中。)

struggle(n./v.)奮鬥、掙扎、努力
(無詞性變化)
struggle with 與…奮鬥
struggle for 為…奮鬥
He struggled with math in high school.
(他高中時數學學得很吃力。)
Life was a struggle for the poor family.
(對那個貧窮的家庭來說，生活很艱辛。)

style(n./v.)風格、樣式、時尚、設計
stylish(adj.)時髦的
in style 流行、有氣派
hair style 髮型
I like your new hair style.
(我喜歡你的新髮型。)
Her writing style is simple and clear.
(她的寫作風格簡單明瞭。)

subway(n.)地下鐵、捷運(美式)
underground(n.)地下鐵(英式)
metro(n.)地鐵、捷運
take the subway 搭地鐵
subway station 地鐵站
I take the subway to school every day.
(我每天搭捷運上學。)
The subway station is near my house.
(地鐵站在我家附近。)

succeed(v.)成功、繼承
success(n.)成功
successful(adj.)成功的
succeed in 在…方面成功
succeed to 繼承
She succeeded in passing the exam.
(她成功通過了考試。)
If at first you don't succeed, try again.
(如果一開始不成功，就再試一次。)

success(n.)成功、成功的人事物
succeed(v.)成功
successful(adj.)成功的
great success 極大的成功
the key to success 成功的關鍵
Hard work is the key to success.
(努力是成功的關鍵。)
The concert was a great success.
(這場音樂會非常成功。)

such(adj./pron.)如此的、這樣的、這樣的人事物
(無詞性變化)
such as 例如
such a 如此的
It was such a nice day.
(那是如此美好的一天。)
I like fruits such as apples and bananas.
(我喜歡蘋果和香蕉之類的水果。)

sudden(adj./n.)突然的、意外的
suddenly(adv.)突然地
all of a sudden 突然
sudden change 突然的改變
All of a sudden, the lights went out.
(突然間，燈全熄了。)
There was a sudden change in the weather.
(天氣突然變了。)

suggest(v.)建議、暗示
suggestion(n.)建議
suggest doing 建議做…
strongly suggest 強烈建議
I suggest taking the bus.
(我建議搭公車。)
The doctor suggested that I get more sleep.
(醫生建議我多睡一點。)

suit(n./v.)西裝、套裝、適合
suitable(adj.)適合的
suit sb. well 很適合某人
wear a suit 穿西裝
My dad wears a suit to work.
(我爸爸穿西裝上班。)
That color suits you well.
(那個顏色很適合你。)

suitable(adj.)適合的、適當的
suit(v.)適合
suitably(adv.)適當地
suitable for 適合…
suitable time 適當的時間
This movie is not suitable for children.
(這部電影不適合兒童觀看。)
Is now a suitable time to talk?
(現在方便談話嗎？)

super(adj./adv.)極好的、超級地
(無詞性變化)
super easy 超級簡單
super cool 超酷
The test was super easy.
(這次考試超級簡單。)
We had a super time at the party.
(我們在派對上玩得超開心。)

supper(n.)晚餐、宵夜
(無詞性變化)
have supper 吃晚餐
late supper 宵夜
We have supper at seven every evening.
(我們每天晚上七點吃晚餐。)
What's for supper tonight?
(今晚晚餐吃什麼？)

supply(n./v.)供應、補給品、提供
supplier(n.)供應商
supply A with B 提供 B 給 A
school supplies 學校用品
The farm supplies the city with milk.
(這座農場為城市供應牛奶。)
I need to buy some school supplies.
(我需要買一些學校用品。)

support(n./v.)支持、支撐、扶養
supporter(n.)支持者
supportive(adj.)支持的
support a team 支持一支球隊
financial support 經濟支援
My parents always support my dreams.
(我的父母總是支持我的夢想。)
Thank you for your support.
(謝謝你的支持。)

suppose(v.)假定、認為、應該
supposedly(adv.)據說
be supposed to 應該
I suppose so 我想是吧
You are supposed to be in class now.
(你現在應該在上課。)
I suppose he is right.
(我想他是對的。)

surf(v.)衝浪、上網瀏覽
surfer(n.)衝浪者
surfing(n.)衝浪
go surfing 去衝浪
surf the Internet 上網
We went surfing in Taitung.
(我們去台東衝浪。)
He surfs the Internet for news every day.
(他每天上網看新聞。)

surface(n./v.)表面、外表、浮出水面
(無詞性變化)
on the surface 表面上
the Earth's surface 地球表面
Water covers most of the Earth's surface.
(水覆蓋了地球表面大部分的地方。)
On the surface, she seemed calm.
(表面上她看起來很冷靜。)

survival(n.)生存、存活
survive(v.)生存
survivor(n.)倖存者
survival skills 求生技能
fight for survival 為生存而戰
Water is necessary for survival.
(水是生存所必需的。)
We learned survival skills at camp.
(我們在營隊學了求生技能。)

survive(v.)存活、倖存、度過
survival(n.)生存
survivor(n.)倖存者
survive an accident 在意外中倖存
survive on 靠…維生
Only two people survived the crash.
(只有兩個人在墜機事故中倖存。)
Plants cannot survive without sunlight.
(植物沒有陽光就無法存活。)

swallow(v./n.)吞下、燕子
(無詞性變化)
swallow food 吞嚥食物
swallow one's pride 放下自尊
It hurts when I swallow.
(我吞東西的時候會痛。)
A swallow built a nest under the roof.
(一隻燕子在屋簷下築了巢。)

sweater(n.)毛衣
(無詞性變化)
wool sweater 羊毛衣
wear a sweater 穿毛衣
It's cold. Put on your sweater.
(天氣很冷，穿上你的毛衣。)
Grandma knitted me a sweater.
(奶奶為我織了一件毛衣。)

sweep(v.)掃、清掃、席捲
sweeper(n.)清掃者、掃地機
sweep the floor 掃地
sweep away 掃除、沖走
Please sweep the floor after class.
(下課後請掃地。)
The flood swept away many houses.
(洪水沖走了許多房屋。)

swim(v./n.)游泳
swimmer(n.)游泳者
swimming(n.)游泳
go for a swim 去游泳
swim across 游過
Can you swim across the river?
(你能游過這條河嗎？)
Let's go for a swim this afternoon.
(我們今天下午去游泳吧。)

swimsuit(n.)泳裝、泳衣
(無詞性變化)
one-piece swimsuit 連身泳衣
bring a swimsuit 帶泳衣
Don't forget to bring your swimsuit.
(別忘了帶你的泳衣。)
She bought a new swimsuit for the trip.
(她為了這趟旅行買了一件新泳衣。)

swing(n./v.)鞦韆、搖擺、揮動
(無詞性變化)
swing a bat 揮棒
mood swings 情緒起伏
The kids are playing on the swings.
(孩子們在盪鞦韆。)
He swung the bat and hit the ball.
(他揮棒擊中了球。)

switch(n./v.)開關、轉換、切換
(無詞性變化)
switch on/off 打開/關掉
light switch 電燈開關
Please switch off the lights.
(請把燈關掉。)
The light switch is next to the door.
